notes.title: Playtest has started!
notes.content: [p]Welcome to testing Vacuum Bless![/p][p]Request access, wait for access, play the game, share your impressions![/p][p][/p][p]This version of the game contains all the main content except some details. Therefore you get the possibility to evaluate the game in almost full.[/p][p]But do not forget to leave feedback. There is an instruction inside the game on how you can do this.[/p][p]If you wish, you can leave contextual messages directly in the game, without having to describe the context. For greater convenience, you can limit yourself to indicating tags like "bad control", "bugs" for any individual moments of the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361421/31f3087d1f06045166d01fe7d6fe3831d70d9952.gif"][/img][/p][p]Sincere thanks to everyone who helps make the game better. It is extremely valuable to me![/p][p][/p][p]Only [b]English[/b] and [b]Russian[/b] languages ​​are available during testing.[/p][p]Testing runs from [b]September 16 to 25[/b].[/p]

notes.title: The game release is scheduled for December 3.
notes.content: [p]Over the last few weeks, the plans for the release have become increasingly clear to me.[/p][p]I am now at a point where I am more or less confident in my abilities, and will strictly focus on the designated date. At least for now there are no obvious obstacles, and I am happy about that.[/p][p][/p]
